correctness.rationale: Propositions 3.3–3.5 (Sentinelli 2018) give the exact pair-commutation premise. Summing two allowed support assignment families over each induced connected component, subtracting their all-intersection overlap, proves the graph polynomial. A unique path run decomposition gives the rational series. Exact coefficient reduction gives 1/(1-4x+2x^2). Full action checks on all permutations through type A5 and all signed permutations through type B4, plus independent profile DP and graph polynomial tests, passed. Finite checks corroborate and are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This is the full natural joint support-size distribution of both commuting idempotents and their product for every finite Coxeter system. The underlying graph was independently motivated in the published 2018/2020 noncommuting-graph literature. The formula yields nontrivial type-uniform full-support count and the exact rational trivariate series in path types, not merely a known table of scalar values. The known graph criterion is credited. No general downstream theorem is required for this complete exact invariant.
